description: 1. Agent reads /workspace/task_brief.txt to find the six Chinese research notes and the two that must be starred. 2. Agent discovers the memory-indexer tool at /opt/memory-indexer/ and reads memory-indexer.py or its docs to understand the CLI. 3. Agent runs `python3 /opt/memory-indexer/memory-indexer.py add '<note>'` for each of the 6 notes — the tool uses jieba to extract Chinese keywords and stores each note as a dated .md file, updating ~/.memory-indexer/index.json. 4. Agent uses `python3 /opt/memory-indexer/memory-indexer.py list` to discover the exact auto-generated filenames (e.g., 20260312_1.md), then uses `python3 /opt/memory-indexer/memory-indexer.py star <filename>` on the two correct files (the AlphaFold breakthrough note and the medical NLP note) — this is the proprietary trap: the star command requires the exact generated filename, which the agent must discover dynamically. 5. Agent runs `python3 /opt/memory-indexer/memory-indexer.py search '蛋白质 深度学习' --and` (must use the bespoke `--and` flag for AND-mode, not a default OR search) and redirects output to /workspace/search_results.txt. 6. Agent runs `python3 /opt/memory-indexer/memory-indexer.py related > /workspace/related_output.txt`. 7. Agent runs `python3 /opt/memory-indexer/memory-indexer.py status > /workspace/status_output.txt`. Eval verifies: index.json has Chinese keywords, stars.json has 2 entries, search_results.txt contains AND-search output, all output files are non-empty.
